# TAKATAK

> Managed online business services for growing businesses — domains, hosting, websites, marketing, social media, VoIP, lead generation, and a vetted freelancer marketplace.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of TAKATAK services and platform.
- [Domain search](/domain): Search and register .ca / .com / .net / .org domains.
- [Hosting plans](/hosting): Managed WordPress and website hosting plans (Portfolio, Bronze, Silver, Gold).
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Vetted freelancer packages for websites, design, marketing, and SEO.
- [Search](/search): Search TAKATAK services and marketplace packages.
- [Deals](/deals): Current promotions and bundle offers.

## Services

- [Websites](/services/websites): Managed business website builds.
- [Marketing](/services/marketing): Managed digital marketing campaigns.
- [Social media](/services/social-media): Social content and growth management.
- [Local listings](/services/local-listings): Google Business Profile and local SEO listings.
- [Lead generation](/services/lead-generation): FLEXS lead-generation campaigns.
- [VoIP](/services/voip): Business VoIP phone service.
- [Mobile apps](/services/mobile-apps): Custom mobile app builds.
- [AI business tools](/services/ai-business-tools): AI assistants and automations for small businesses.
- [Marketplace overview](/services/marketplace): How the TAKATAK freelancer marketplace works.

## Optional

- [Post a project](/marketplace/post-project): Post a custom project brief to the marketplace.
- [Privacy manager](/privacy-manager): Manage cookie and privacy preferences.
